tests.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_metric_semantics.py tests/test_metrics.py tests/test_project_remote.py tests/test_analysis_ui.py tests/test_quick_advisor.py tests/test_research_autolink.py tests/test_analysis_raster_zoom.py tests/test_analysis_selection_clear.py tests/test_qol_charts.py tests/test_charts_extremes.py --disable-warnings --maxfail=3

limits: synthetic local filesystem; no live Slurm,GPU or remote latency measurement
isolated stdlib SSH helper execution tests use a local subprocess, not a live SSH cluster
process peak RSS is not Python allocation measurement
one default stream read, no all-rank fanout or aggregation
rolling median uses seven displayed columns and does not alter observations
Small same-host samples vary with process scheduling and Python garbage collection; no universal overhead bound is established.
Reader/source hashes identify the qualified working-tree bytes, not a later integrated commit.

methods.reader_note: Recorded runs used an equivalent fixed-fixture precursor of the published guarded CLI harness. Its source SHA-256 is retained below. The CLI adds argument parsing, validation and provenance fields without changing the 64×600 fixture or timed read loop.
methods.reader_initialization: One complete warmup read outside timing; 60 unchanged-stream snapshots in each fresh process. The sidecar declares all 64 metrics as residuals.
methods.render_note: Supplemental cached-screen measurements collected before the final empty-canonical rank-fallback correction. This fixture contains no rank index or sidecar; these render reports do not identify the final integrated revision.
